name: Is luxury vinyl flooring a good replacement for an uneven kitchen floor?

mainEntity.name: Is luxury vinyl flooring a good replacement for an uneven kitchen floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury vinyl can be a practical kitchen option when the subfloor is properly prepared, especially if comfort, easier cleaning, and a lower-maintenance surface matter. It is not a way to ignore dips, movement, moisture, or damaged underlayment. Context: Uneven or flexible bases can contribute to failed rigid flooring, while floating vinyl still needs the manufacturer’s required flatness and expansion conditions. Key factors: - Plank or tile installation method - Subfloor flatness - Water exposure at appliances and sinks - Transition height Practical guidance: Ask for a substrate evaluation and clarify whether existing flooring will be removed or covered. Elite Remodeling & Design can compare the flooring choice with cabinetry, appliance placement, and adjacent-room finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury vinyl may handle normal household use well, but it does not correct an uneven or unstable base. Check flatness, moisture, movement, and underlayment requirements first; otherwise the new floor may telegraph defects or separate.
